evals.name: claims-vs-enforcement
evals.prompt: Which of our rules are actually enforced? CONTRIBUTING says: no direct pushes to main, all PRs need passing tests, domain code never imports infrastructure, no secrets in the repo.
evals.expected_output: Finds the enforcement for each claim by reading CI run lines, branch protection (or reports it could not be checked), hooks and lint configs; notes coverage (Claude-only hook vs git hook vs CI); marks each enforced/partial/convention; writes or updates critical-infrastructure.md; ranks gaps by blast radius; ends with one next action.
expectations: Checks branch protection or explicitly says it could not
Distinguishes Claude Code-only enforcement from enforcement that covers all agents
Marks each claim enforced/partial/convention with evidence
Ends with exactly one next action
